prompt: Build a seat-count pricing slider. Use a real <input type="range" min="1" max="30"> styled with a 6px pill track whose filled part is a linear-gradient driven by a --p custom property (set to the slider percentage on every input event) and an 18px white thumb with a layered shadow that scales to 1.18 while pressed. Above it show the seat count; below it show the total: seats x unit price, set in a large semibold tabular-nums figure so the width does not jitter. Make the total roll to its new value instead of jumping: keep a displayed value and ease it toward the target in requestAnimationFrame (displayed += (target - displayed) * 0.16) and write Math.round(displayed) each frame, stopping when within 0.5. Show the per-seat price in small muted text. Add an aria-live="polite" region that announces only the final total, debounced, not every frame. Keyboard arrows must work natively.
